newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWEDISH SHARES DEEPEN LOSSES AFTER ASTRA RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: SWEDISH SHARES DEEPEN LOSSES AFTER ASTRA RESULTS.

text.p: Swedish share prices deepened losses by mid-session on Friday, as drug group Astra depressed the market after sliding on disappointing six-month results.
At 1025 GMT the general index had fallen 0.81 percent to 3,250.41 in turnover totalling 1.9 billion crowns.

Astra tumbled on Friday after it posted a slightly lower than expected pre-tax profit for the first six months of the year, a four percent rise in pre-tax profit to 7.01 billion crowns against expectations of 7.18 billion crowns.
The share was seven crowns lower at 145.5, off lows, compared to 151.5 before the figures were released.

"Sales looked good but the currency effects are bringing the share down. Now everyone is waiting for the news conference this afternoon," one broker said. Astra is due to hold a news conference at 1100 GMT.
"Foreign players are selling," one broker said.
Shares in property company Gotic rose 1.7 crown to 18.6 on news Vasakronan was buying it for 19 crowns per share.
